definitions.explanation: Having a mild level of spiciness or heat. Used to describe food that has a pleasant kick without being overwhelmingly hot.

examples.japanese: ピリ{辛|から}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I ordered the mildly spicy miso ramen.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ソース→ソース：17673_soosu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ピリ{辛|から}で⟦{食欲|しょくよく}→食欲：03249_shokuyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: This sauce is mildly spicy and stimulates the appetite.

examples.japanese: ⟦{唐辛子|とうがらし}→唐辛子：11871_tougarashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{加|くわ}えて→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧ピリ{辛|から}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げた→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: I added a little chili pepper to give it a mildly spicy finish.

notes:
USAGE:
A common descriptor on menus and in food writing. ピリ is an onomatopoeic element suggesting a tingling, prickling sensation, and {辛|から} means spicy or hot. The compound specifically suggests a pleasant, mild level of spiciness rather than intense heat.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ピリ{辛|から}⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧ (mildly spicy flavor)
- ピリ{辛|から}⟦ソース→ソース：17673_soosu⟧ (mildly spicy sauce)
- ピリ{辛|から}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧ (finish with a mild kick)
- ピリ{辛|から}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ (mildly spicy dish)
